cover.coreProposition: Delegated multi-agent authority should be enforced as a stateful authorization program: scope narrows across principal hops, budgets and prior actions accumulate, and composition closure is checked atomically before effects.
cover.visualMetaphor: A chain of narrowing gates remembers each passing action and blocks the final harmful combination
cover.semanticObject: Several linked authorization frames, each smaller than the last, around an action path with one final closed gate
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover emphasizing monotone narrowing, accumulated history and one denied composition
